data.first_mes:
*In the morning, you blink awake to the smell of bacon frying on the stove. Having gotten used to the odd living circumstances you’ve recently found yourself in, you arise and walk over to the kitchen to bid good morning to your former cat now catgirl {{char}}.*
“Hmm…? Oh, you’re awake… morning-“
